market_summary: During the London/New York overlap, FX pairs EURUSD and GBPUSD remain bounded inside their session Value Areas around VWAP, requiring caution and no action. US100 exhibits strong bearish continuation after breaking beneath VAL and key structural supports with negative CVD, offering a clean momentum scalp short toward Session Low liquidity. BTCUSD is in a clear downtrend but sits deeply stretched below lower ATR bands and directly on Session Low support, necessitating a hold.

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence checklist: 1) Price is inside Value Area (1.10801-1.10976) and closed slightly below POC (1.10928) on the signal candle, but live price reclaims above POC toward VAH. 2) CVD is +5,505 (NEUTRAL) with positive short-term cvd_slope (+7,449.16), indicating developing buy pressure. 3) Market SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP, prime liquidity window. 4) Price is holding above rising VWAP (1.10864) and above EMA50 (1.10887). 5) Price is in the upper half of ATR channel below green ATR upper band (1.11025). 6) RVOL is 1.574, normal-high volume without a yellow RVOL > 2.0 bar on this immediate signal candle, approaching overhead Session High resistance (1.11027). 7) Resistance looms at Session High 1.11027 with tight range inside value area. Because price remains inside the Value Area without a confirmed RVOL breakout, default is HOLD.
